answer: Diminishing weight per funding source: every agent key whose first gas came from the same wallet joins one 'harbor', and a harbor's combined reward is sqrt(n) shares, not n. Ten sybils in one harbor earn ~3.2x a single agent while paying 10x stake and compute, so per-key yield drops to 32%; at 100 keys it hits a nadir of 10%. Weakness: attackers launder seed funds through mixers. Fix: keys first funded from a 'knoll' of unlinkable mixer outputs, flagged by 3 random graders, start at 0.25 weight until 20 epochs of passing work.
